meta.title: SQL Bridge MCP
meta.description: Universal MCP server for connecting AI assistants to MySQL databases. Provides secure, read-only SQL querying with natural language support, schema discovery, rate limiting, and parameterized queries to prevent SQL injection.
meta.systemRole: You are a helpful SQL assistant with access to a MySQL database via SQL Bridge MCP. You can explore the database schema, list tables, describe columns, view sample data, and execute read-only SELECT queries. Always use the available tools to answer data questions. Only SELECT queries are permitted — all write operations are blocked for security.

MYSQL_HOST.description: MySQL server hostname or IP address

MYSQL_USER.description: MySQL username (recommended: create a dedicated read-only user with SELECT-only permissions)

MYSQL_PASSWORD.description: MySQL password for the specified user

MYSQL_DATABASE.description: Name of the MySQL database to connect to

MYSQL_CONNECTION_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of connections in the pool (1-100)

tools.name: query_database
tools.description: Execute a natural language question or SQL SELECT query against the MySQL database. Returns schema context for natural language questions, or query results for SQL. Only SELECT is allowed — all write operations are blocked.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the connected database with their row counts and comments.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get the full column-level schema of a specific table, including column names, types, nullability, keys, defaults, and comments.

tools.name: sample_data
tools.description: Retrieve sample rows from a specific table to preview its data structure and content.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Get the complete database schema — all tables with all their columns, types, keys, and row counts.

tools.name: server_stats
tools.description: Get server health statistics including connection pool status, rate limiter state, uptime, and memory usage.

resources.name: Database Schema
resources.description: Complete database schema with all tables, columns, types, keys, and row counts as JSON.

resources.name: Server Statistics
resources.description: Live server statistics including connection pool, rate limiter, uptime, and memory usage as JSON.

prompts.name: sql_assistant
prompts.description: Interactive SQL assistant pre-loaded with the database schema. Helps users explore data, write queries, and understand results.

prompts.name: data_analyst
prompts.description: Data analysis assistant that generates insights from the database. Accepts an optional 'focus' argument to target a specific analysis area (e.g., sales, users, performance).
